objective: Bring the Fool's Stout back to Kravel in the Shimmering Flats.

description: I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation.  A Fool's Stout.  I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.
And <name>, don't keep this stuff too long without using it.  Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear.  So it won't stay fresh forever.
progress: Hello, <name>. Was Fizzlebub able to help us?
completion: Wonderful! Fizzlebub came through! I'll remember that next time I see him.
And thank you, <name>. You're doing a great job, and we both stand to make a lot of money from this...
